reasons: The two inserted coverages complete the E&O (USD 2M) and cyber/privacy (USD 5M) legs of the preferred position and comfortably clear the fallback thresholds.

Preferred is not fully achieved: the existing Commercial General Liability item carries no limits, and no USD 1M per-occurrence / USD 2M aggregate figures were inserted. A short limit insertion in item 1 would close this gap.
Workers' compensation and certificates-on-request already existed and remain effective, so no further edits were needed there.
Minimality is satisfied: only two concise new coverage items were added to an otherwise untouched clause, with no rewrite of Section B or of existing coverages.
Drafting nit: the insert uses lower-case "Customer data" rather than the document's defined term for Customer Data; aligning capitalisation would avoid any argument about scope.
